wizard.title: New booking
wizard.taken: That time was just taken. Pick another one.
wizard.no_tenants_title: No warehouse to book at yet
wizard.no_tenants: A warehouse has to invite you or approve your registration first.

where.title: Where and what
where.description: Pick the warehouse you deliver to and what the truck carries. The load type decides the duration.
where.tenant_hint: Only warehouses that work with you appear here.
where.no_load_types: This site offers no load types for carriers.

when.title: When
when.description: Only start times that fit the site's hours, closures and free capacity are offered.
when.rules: The site needs {{hours}} hours lead time and takes bookings up to {{days}} days ahead.

avis.title: Avis
avis.description: Tell the warehouse what arrives. Required fields follow the site's settings.

slot.no_times: No start times left on this day.

cutoff.passed: Changes are closed for this booking.

driver.title: Driver link
driver.description: One link with the slot, the address, the safety briefing in the driver's language and the dock call. No app, no account.
driver.inactive: This booking has no active driver link.
driver.share_text: Your slot, address and safety briefing for booking {{code}}
driver.regenerate_description: The current link stops working at once and shows "no longer valid". Send the new link to the driver.

list.title: Bookings
list.description: Your slots at every warehouse that works with you. Times are shown in each site's local time.
list.pending_title: Registration at {{name}} is waiting for approval
list.pending: You can book there as soon as their dispatcher approves your request.
list.empty: Bookings you make show up here, at every warehouse.

detail.code_hint: The gate scans this code or the driver's link.
detail.link_inactive: The warehouse has paused your link. You can still cancel.

reschedule.title: Change time of {{code}}
reschedule.description: Pick a new start. The warehouse checks capacity again and emails you the change.

cancel.title: Cancel booking {{code}}?
cancel.description: The slot is freed at once and the driver link stops working.
